prompt_text: I need braces or Invisalign in Denver. Which specific orthodontists should I call, and why?
q1_prompt_text: Who is the best orthodontist in Denver for braces or Invisalign?
answer_verbatim:
I can give you specific names — but to make the list most useful I need a couple quick details: your Denver zip code (or neighborhood), whether this is for an adult or a teen/child, and whether you have dental insurance or a budget range. If you want Invisalign specifically say so.

While you reply, here’s a practical plan plus what to call and why — so you can start right away if you prefer.

What to call first (general, useful no matter your location or age)
- A nearby board-certified orthodontist (ABO diplomate) — board certification means additional testing and peer review; good for complex cases.
- An experienced Invisalign provider (Platinum/Diamond status on Invisalign locator) if you want clear aligners — that indicates high volume and familiarity with tricky aligner cases.
- A pediatric orthodontist if this is for a child/teen (their training focuses on growth and timing).
- The University of Colorado orthodontic residency clinic (if cost is a concern or you have a complex case) — supervised care from residents can be lower cost.

How to find specific names right away
- Use Invisalign’s “Find a Provider” and filter for Diamond/Platinum providers near Denver.
- Use the American Association of Orthodontists (AAO) “Find an Orthodontist” lookup to confirm membership.
- Check Google/Yelp/Healthgrades for recent patient reviews and before/after photos.
- Verify “ABO diplomate” status on the American Board of Orthodontics site if you want board-certified.

What I recommend you call (what to ask and why)
Call 3–4 practices: one high-volume Invisalign provider, one ABO diplomate, one pediatric orthodontist (if applicable), and one lower-cost/university option. On the call, ask:
- Are you an Invisalign provider? (If yes: what level — e.g., Platinum/Diamond?)
- Are you board certified by the American Board of Orthodontics?
- Do you offer a free or low-cost initial consult and 3D scans (iTero or similar)?
- Estimated cost range for braces vs Invisalign and what’s included (retainers, adjustments).
- Typical treatment time for cases like mine (briefly describe crowding, spacing, overbite, etc.)
- Payment/financing options and whether you accept my insurance.

Sample phone script (30–45 seconds)
“Hi, I’m interested in orthodontic treatment and wondering whether you treat adults/teens with Invisalign or braces. Do you offer a free consultation and digital scans? Are you an Invisalign Platinum/Diamond provider and/or board certified by the American Board of Orthodontics? Also, do you accept [my insurance name] or offer financing?”

If you want, I can:
- Provide a tailored list of 4–6 specific Denver orthodontists (with phone numbers and short reasons to call) if you tell me your zip code, age, and insurance status.
- Or I can run the Invisalign/AAO searches for you and summarize the best local matches (I’ll need your location).
